# Store & Purchase Management System – Generated Documents Catalog & Data Entry Forms Specification

This specification is divided into two comprehensive parts:
- **PART 1**: Catalog of all official documents, note sheets, certificates, and vouchers to be auto-generated by the system.
- **PART 2**: Exhaustive specification of all UI forms, user input fields, data types, validation rules, and database schema mappings.

---

# PART 2: UI Forms & Data Input Field Specifications

Below are the detailed specifications for every data entry interface required in the system.

---

### Form 1: Department Master & Governance Setup
- **Form ID**: `FORM-01`
- **Purpose**: Manage academic departments, administrative sections, designated Department Representatives, and discipline Expert Committees.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Department Code | `dept_code` | Text Input | String (10) | Mandatory | Unique uppercase (e.g. `MECH`, `CIVIL`, `COMP`) | `departments.code` |
| Department Name | `dept_name` | Text Input | String (100) | Mandatory | Full Department Name | `departments.name` |
| Department Head (HOD) | `hod_user_id` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | Active Faculty List | `users.id` |
| Dept Rep 1 Name & Desig | `rep1_user_id` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | Active Department Faculty/Staff | `users.id` |
| Dept Rep 2 Name & Desig | `rep2_user_id` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | Active Department Faculty/Staff | `users.id` |
| Expert Committee Members | `expert_member_ids` | Multi-Select | Array[Integer]| Mandatory | Minimum 3, Maximum 5 domain experts | `users.id` |

---

### Form 2: CTE Annual Demand Entry (Statements 1 to 5)
- **Form ID**: `FORM-02`
- **Purpose**: Capture departmental item demands for submission in the annual CTE proposal.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Financial Year | `fin_year` | Select Dropdown | String (7) | Mandatory | e.g., `2026-27` | `cte_demands.fin_year` |
| Category | `category` | Select Dropdown | Enum | Mandatory | `Non-IT Equipment`, `IT Equipment`, `Furniture`, `Books`, `Maintenance` | `cte_demands.category` |
| Item Name | `item_name` | Text Input | String (200) | Mandatory | Full item nomenclature | `cte_demands.item_name` |
| Quantity Required | `qty_required` | Number Input | Integer | Mandatory | Min: 1 | `cte_demands.qty` |
| Approx Rate as per GeM (Rs) | `approx_unit_rate` | Currency Input | Decimal (12,2)| Mandatory | Greater than 0 | `cte_demands.unit_rate` |
| Total Estimated Cost (Rs) | `total_cost` | Computed Field | Decimal (12,2)| Auto-calculated| `= Qty * Approx Unit Rate` | `cte_demands.total_cost` |
| Department / Discipline | `dept_id` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | User's department | `departments.id` |
| Available on GeM? | `is_gem_available` | Radio Buttons | Boolean | Mandatory | `Yes`, `No` | `cte_demands.gem_available` |
| GeM Product ID / Link | `gem_product_id` | Text Input | String (100) | Optional | Mandatory if GeM Available = Yes | `cte_demands.gem_id` |
| Proposed Grant Head | `grant_head` | Select Dropdown | Enum | Mandatory | `State Grant (TED-5)`, `State Grant (TED-11)`, `Center Grant`, `Other` | `cte_demands.grant_head` |
| Demanded against Condemn item?| `against_condemn` | Radio Buttons | Boolean | Mandatory | `Yes`, `No` | `cte_demands.against_condemn` |
| Total Qty Required as per Norms| `norm_qty` | Number Input | Integer | Mandatory | Calculated per AICTE/GTU norms | `cte_demands.norm_qty` |
| Currently Available Qty | `available_qty` | Number Input | Integer | Mandatory | Existing working/non-working stock | `cte_demands.available_qty` |
| Condition of Available Stock | `available_condition`| Select Dropdown | Enum | Mandatory | `Working`, `Non-Working`, `Obsolete`, `Not as per requirement` | `cte_demands.stock_condition` |
| Lifespan of Demanded Item | `estimated_lifespan`| Text Input | String (50) | Mandatory | e.g., `7 Years`, `10 Years` | `cte_demands.lifespan` |
| Maintenance Execution Plan | `maintenance_plan` | Textarea | Text | Mandatory | AMC / Self Maintenance / Manufacturer Warranty | `cte_demands.maint_plan` |
| Detailed Technical Justification| `justification` | Textarea | Text | Mandatory | Academic / Lab / Research necessity | `cte_demands.justification` |

---

### Form 3: Purchase Indent Entry Form
- **Form ID**: `FORM-03`
- **Purpose**: Initiate a purchase requisition for an approved item under Govt. or Non-Govt. funds.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Fund Type | `fund_type` | Radio Buttons | Enum | Mandatory | `Govt Fund`, `Non-Govt Fund` | `indents.fund_type` |
| Non-Govt Budget Head | `non_govt_head` | Select Dropdown | Enum | Conditional | `Student Welfare`, `Student Amenities`, `Gymkhana`, `CoE Siemens`, `SSIP`, `Domus`, `Incubation` | `indents.budget_head` |
| Department | `dept_id` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | User Department | `departments.id` |
| Indent Date | `indent_date` | Date Picker | Date | Mandatory | Today's Date | `indents.indent_date` |
| Item Name & Specifications | `item_description` | Textarea | Text | Mandatory | Comprehensive item details | `indents.item_desc` |
| Quantity Required | `quantity` | Number Input | Integer | Mandatory | Min: 1 | `indents.qty` |
| Estimated Unit Cost (Rs) | `unit_cost` | Currency Input | Decimal (12,2)| Mandatory | Unit rate | `indents.unit_cost` |
| Estimated Total Cost (Rs) | `total_cost` | Computed Field | Decimal (12,2)| Auto-calculated| `= Qty * Unit Cost` | `indents.total_cost` |
| GeM Product ID / Status | `gem_details` | Text Input | String (100) | Optional | If searched on GeM | `indents.gem_details` |

---

### Form 4: Specification & Consignee Allocation Form
- **Form ID**: `FORM-04`
- **Purpose**: Define technical specifications, consignee department breakdown, and Expert Committee endorsement.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Indent ID | `indent_id` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | Approved Indent List | `indents.id` |
| Item Name | `item_name` | Text Input | String (200) | Mandatory | Pre-filled from Indent | `specifications.item_name` |
| Technical Specifications | `detailed_specs` | Rich Text Editor | Text | Mandatory | Parametric specifications list | `specifications.specs_text` |
| Additional Notes | `spec_notes` | Textarea | Text | Optional | Additional testing / ISO standard requirements | `specifications.notes` |
| Consignee Department 1 | `consignee_dept_1` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | Department | `departments.id` |
| Consignee Qty 1 | `consignee_qty_1` | Number Input | Integer | Mandatory | Qty for Department 1 | `consignees.qty` |
| Consignee Department 2... | `consignee_dept_2` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Optional | Secondary Department | `departments.id` |
| Expert Committee Signatories | `expert_signatures` | Checkbox Group | Array[Integer]| Mandatory | All designated expert committee members must check/verify | `specifications.signatures` |

### Form 5: Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) Form
- **Form ID**: `FORM-05`
- **Purpose**: Configure custom terms, warranty conditions, service SLA, and financial security requirements.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Delivery Location | `delivery_location`| Text Input | String (200) | Mandatory | Default: `Central Library / Dept, LDCE, Ahmedabad` | `atc.delivery_loc` |
| Installation Scope | `installation_scope`| Textarea | Text | Mandatory | Inclusive of wiring, MCB, accessories, stand, drilling | `atc.installation` |
| Preventive Service Interval | `service_interval` | Select Dropdown | String (50) | Mandatory | `Every 3 Months`, `Every 6 Months`, `On Demand` | `atc.service_interval` |
| Breakdown Response Time | `response_time` | Select Dropdown | String (50) | Mandatory | `Within 24 Hours`, `Within 48 Hours` | `atc.response_time` |
| Maximum Allowed Downtime | `max_downtime` | Select Dropdown | String (50) | Mandatory | `3 Days`, `5 Days`, `7 Days` | `atc.max_downtime` |
| Warranty Period | `warranty_period` | Select Dropdown | String (50) | Mandatory | `1 Year Comprehensive`, `2 Years`, `3 Years` | `atc.warranty` |
| Local Office / Service Center | `local_office_clause`| Radio Buttons | String (100) | Mandatory | `Must be within 50 km of Ahmedabad`, `Establish within 30 days` | `atc.local_office` |
| Security Deposit (e-PBG) % | `epbg_percentage` | Select Dropdown | Decimal (4,2) | Mandatory | `5% of Contract Value`, `3% (for MSME)` | `atc.epbg_percent` |
| EMD Amount (Rs) | `emd_amount` | Currency Input | Decimal (10,2)| Mandatory | 3% of Bid Value | `atc.emd_amount` |

### Form 9: DLPC / DPC Meeting & Sanction Form
- **Form ID**: `FORM-09`
- **Purpose**: Capture Minutes of Meeting, L1 rate reasonability verification, and committee approval.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Sanction Body | `committee_type` | Radio Buttons | Enum | Mandatory | `DLPC (≤ Rs 5.00 Lakhs)`, `DPC (> Rs 5.00 Lakhs)` | `committee_meetings.type` |
| Meeting Date & Ref No | `meeting_ref` | Text Input | String (100) | Mandatory | e.g. `LDCE/DLPC/2026-27/04` | `committee_meetings.ref_no` |
| L1 Vendor Name & City | `l1_vendor` | Text Input | String (200) | Mandatory | Verified L1 Vendor | `committee_meetings.l1_vendor` |
| Total L1 Amount (Rs) | `l1_amount` | Currency Input | Decimal (12,2)| Mandatory | Final evaluated L1 rate | `committee_meetings.l1_amount` |
| Reasonability Certification | `rate_reasonability`| Textarea | Text | Mandatory | Certification that L1 rate matches market survey | `committee_meetings.reasonability` |
| Committee Recommendation | `recommendation` | Textarea | Text | Mandatory | Resolution recommending purchase order placement | `committee_meetings.resolution` |
| Committee Members Present | `attendee_ids` | Multi-Select | Array[Integer]| Mandatory | Checked against Committee Master | `committee_meetings.attendees` |

### Form 10: Technical Inspection & Goods Inward Form
- **Form ID**: `FORM-10`
- **Purpose**: Record physical goods arrival, expert inspection parameters, and serial numbers.

| Supplier Name | `supplier_name` | Read-only | String (200) | Auto-filled | From Order Entry | `orders.supplier_name` |
| Invoice Number & Date | `invoice_no_date` | Text Input | String (100) | Mandatory | e.g., `INV-9821 dt. 12/08/2026` | `inspections.invoice_info` |

| Specifications Verified? | `specs_verified` | Radio Buttons | Boolean | Mandatory | `Yes`, `No` | `inspections.specs_ok` |

### Form 11: Pass for Payment Voucher Form
- **Form ID**: `FORM-11`
- **Purpose**: Pass vendor bill for disbursement, calculate retentions/taxes, and assign Central Stock Folio.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Sanction Ref & Date | `sanction_ref` | Text Input | String (100) | Mandatory | DPC/DLPC Sanction order ref | `payment_vouchers.sanction_ref` |
| Vendor Name & Address | `vendor_info` | Read-only | Text | Auto-filled | From PO/Order | `payment_vouchers.vendor_info` |
| Invoice Value (Gross Rs) | `gross_amount` | Currency Input | Decimal (12,2)| Mandatory | Total Bill Amount | `payment_vouchers.gross_amt` |
| Central Stock Register Folio | `stock_folio_no` | Text Input | String (100) | Mandatory | e.g., `Vol 3, Page 142` | `payment_vouchers.stock_folio` |
| Head of Account (Grant) | `account_head` | Select Dropdown | String (100) | Mandatory | Grant budget head | `payment_vouchers.account_head` |
| Security Deposit Retention | `sd_retained` | Currency Input | Decimal (10,2)| Optional | Amount retained if DD not submitted | `payment_vouchers.sd_retained` |
| Other Deductions (Penalty/TDS)| `other_deductions` | Currency Input | Decimal (10,2)| Optional | TDS / LD penalty deductions | `payment_vouchers.deductions` |
| Net Payable Amount (Rs) | `net_payable` | Computed Field | Decimal (12,2)| Auto-calculated| `= Gross Amount - Deductions` | `payment_vouchers.net_payable` |
| Checklist D & E Verified? | `chk_d_e_verified` | Checkbox | Boolean | Mandatory | Must be checked before passing bill | `payment_vouchers.chk_de` |

### Form 12: Non-Working Equipment & Repair Request Form
- **Form ID**: `FORM-12`
- **Purpose**: Log damaged/non-working equipment and initiate repair approval or work order.

| Field Label | Attribute ID | Control Type | Data Type | Requirement | Default / Validation / Options | DB Relationship |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Department | `dept_id` | Select Dropdown | Integer | Mandatory | User Department | `departments.id` |
| Name of Equipment/Instrument | `equipment_name` | Text Input | String (200) | Mandatory | Complete item name | `repair_requests.equipment_name` |
| Original Date of Purchase | `purchase_date` | Date Picker | Date | Mandatory | Date item was bought | `repair_requests.purchase_date` |
| Original Purchase Cost (Rs) | `original_cost` | Currency Input | Decimal (12,2)| Mandatory | Historical cost | `repair_requests.original_cost` |
| Date Since Non-Working | `breakdown_date` | Date Picker | Date | Mandatory | Date fault occurred | `repair_requests.breakdown_date` |
| Previously Repaired? | `prev_repaired` | Radio Buttons | Boolean | Mandatory | `Yes`, `No` | `repair_requests.prev_repaired` |
| Date & Amount of Last Repair | `last_repair_info` | Text Input | String (150) | Optional | Conditional if Previously Repaired = Yes | `repair_requests.last_repair` |
| Prevailing Market Value (Rs)| `market_value` | Currency Input | Decimal (12,2)| Mandatory | Current estimated value | `repair_requests.market_value` |
| Estimated Repair Cost (Rs) | `est_repair_cost` | Currency Input | Decimal (12,2)| Mandatory | Estimated cost of repair | `repair_requests.repair_cost` |
| Detailed Fault Description | `fault_desc` | Textarea | Text | Mandatory | Explanation of defect | `repair_requests.fault_desc` |
